title: Ash and Timber
offer: In your sleep you see a woodcutter with a worn krama knotted at his neck, resting his axe against a great tree. He seems to be remembering something, and the dream lingers when you wake. Follow the memory?

steps.text: Find one of the great landmarks the woodcutter remembers
steps.memory: He used to rest beneath the old giants of the forest. He said they kept count of the years better than any calendar.

steps.text: Found a camp of your own (place an outpost flag)
steps.memory: Every season he built a small camp and left it a little better than he found it, for whoever came next. It was a kind of promise, kept quietly.

steps.text: Decide how to honour the woodcutter's memory
steps.prompt: The dream returns one last time. The woodcutter smiles and turns away down a trail you have walked yourself. What do you do with his memory?

options.label: Carve his trail
options.description: Mark the paths he loved. You receive 2 Trail Signs and a little Crafting experience.

effects.text: A trail sign by your camp still points the way the woodcutter walked.

options.result: You cut his marks into fresh signs, so his trail continues.

options.label: Let it rest
options.description: Let the memory go and see the land as he did. The country around you is revealed on your map, and Exploration grows.

effects.text: You never learned the woodcutter's name, but the paths he walked stay open to you.

options.result: The dream fades gently, and the land around you feels known.

title: The River's Secret
offer: The stepping stones are worn smooth by many feet. Someone used to cross here to fish the deep pools. Learn the river's ways?

steps.memory: The old crossings were made for fishers: the deep pools beside them are always the richest.
Fishers here always shared their first good catch. It was said the river was kinder to those who did.

steps.text: Decide what to do with your catch
steps.prompt: You hold 2 Grilled Fish, warm in their leaves. The fishers of old shared their first good catch. What do you do?

options.label: Share the catch
options.description: Leave 2 Grilled Fish as an offering. From now on your fishing window is wider, and Foraging grows.

effects.text: Along the rivers, the fish seem to rise a little more willingly for you.

options.result: You set the fish on a flat stone by the water and leave them there. The river runs on, and the water seems kinder.

options.label: Follow the stones
options.description: Keep the catch and trace the old crossings. The river country around you is revealed on your map, and Exploration grows.

effects.text: You still know the hidden crossings for days around.

options.result: You follow the worn stones from bank to bank until the whole river country is clear in your mind.

title: Embers in the Stone
offer: As the reliquary opens, a warm ember glows in the stone beneath it, like a coal that never went out. Something about the old lamps is unfinished. Find out what?

steps.text: Drive off two restless spirits at night
steps.memory: The lamps were lit so travellers could rest within the ruins' walls without fear of the dark.

steps.text: Read three of the stone tablets
steps.memory: The tablets speak of keepers who tended the lamps until the promise with the forest was broken.

steps.text: Decide what to do with the ember
steps.prompt: The ember pulses in your hand, warm and patient. It could relight the old lamps for every traveller, or light your own way. Which will it be?

options.label: Rekindle the lamps
options.description: Return the ember's warmth to the ruins. No creatures appear near any ruin whose puzzle you have solved.

effects.text: The old lamps burn again in the ruins you opened, and travellers rest there safely.

options.result: The ember sinks into the stone, and a faint glow spreads through the old lamp channels.

options.label: Keep the ember
options.description: Bind the ember into an Ember Lantern, a lasting light that outlasts a torch. You receive 1 Ember Lantern and Survival grows.

effects.text: Your Ember Lantern still glows on the darkest nights.

options.result: You cradle the ember in a bamboo frame, and the Ember Lantern glows steadily, asking for nothing.
